mapper.select: SELECT n.noti_no, n.noti_type, n.ref_no, n.content, n.is_read, n.created_at, CASE WHEN n.noti_type = 'DEADLINE' THEN DATEDIFF(b.apply_end_date, CURDATE()) END AS d_day FROM notification n LEFT JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_no = n.ref_no AND n.noti_type = 'DEADLINE' WHERE n.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.noti_no DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND is_read = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_no, noti_type, ref_no, content) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{notiType}, #{refNo}, #{content})

INSERT INTO notification (member_no, noti_type, ref_no, content) SELECT f.member_no, 'DEADLINE', b.benefit_no, CONCAT('관심 혜택 ', b.plcy_nm, '의 신청이 ', DATE_FORMAT(b.apply_end_date, '%c월 %e일'), '에 마감돼요.') FROM favorite_benefit f JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_no = f.benefit_no WHERE f.member_no = #{memberNo} AND b.api_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.is_active = 'Y' -- aply_prd_se_cd 는 nullable 이라 != 만 쓰면 NULL 행이 통째로 사라진다 AND (b.aply_prd_se_cd IS NULL OR b.aply_prd_se_cd != '0057003') AND b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() AND b.apply_end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.member_no = f.member_no AND n.noti_type = 'DEADLINE' AND n.ref_no = b.benefit_no ) -- 가입 시 '혜택 알림 수신'(terms_no = 3)에 동의한 회원에게만 보낸다 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_terms_agree a WHERE a.member_no = f.member_no AND a.terms_no = 3 AND a.is_agreed = 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 'Y' WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND is_read = 'N'
